text.text_excerpt: One thing everyone has to acknowledge about this place is the service is simply beyond reproach. It's exceptional and they try to take care of you and give you a memorable experience. Also, it's recommended to dress up here, I don't know if there's a dress code but we all wore dress shirts and slacks and glad we did. This was the second time I came here, the first time was memorable because Emeril himself made a surprise appearance. It was about 3 years ago when the Saints just defeated Brett Favre and the Minnesota Vikings in the playoffs in overtime at New Orleans (they went on to win the Superbowl). I got to shake Emeril's hand and though he wouldn't pose for a picture, he was extremel...

Oh how lovely! My husband's friend came to town and wanted to treat us to a special dinner. We decided on Delmonico and I am so glad we did. First of all, I was impressed by the LOVELY ambiance and decor. It's simple, elegant, and warm. We waited in the bar for the maitre'd to seat us at our table. It has a very intimate feel, and the lighting is nothing short of perfect. The service is impeccable, we had one staff person for each of us essentially. I am pregnant, but clearly the wine and drinks are not to be missed. We started this lovely meal with a cheese plate.. we allowed our server to select the cheeses and they were all phenomenal, served with baguettes and house made pepper jam an...

Been to Delmonico's a few times, albeit several years apart...and it was perfection - as usual. Hit up GW Fins last night and K-Paul's the night before, but Emeril's blows them away every time. Lounge made me an Ol' Fashioned with muddled raspberries (upon request) to get warmed up - hit the spot! Wife had fuzzy navel and a mimosa. Appetizers: Crab remick - my new favorite crab dish of all time. Warm, rich, cheesy crab dip with bacon and toasted french bread...can't go wrong. Then we had the shrimp stuffed mirliton.
